services.name: Input_WaitForNeutralController
services.behavior: Repeats both Z80-handoff controller samples until both neutral masks match, then restores the caller's D0 word and returns.

services.name: Level_PrepareTerminalTransitionFrame
services.behavior: Calls VDP_ClearVRAM_C000 and Frame_RunServicePass. The following controller polling block is statically unreachable because the local counter starts at 0x0103 and is immediately compared against 0x00D2.

conclusion: The scene transition path now distinguishes the active neutral-controller wait from the terminal-transition frame preparation helper. The inactive controller block in 0x001B2802 is retained as exact dead-code evidence rather than being presented as live behavior.
